evidence.description: Direct access to User.shared.analyticsId for assignment

candidates.explanation: The component accesses the 'User' global singleton via '.shared' to read and write state (analyticsId, cookieConsentValue, seedCount, etc.), creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or test.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

candidates.explanation: The 'User' singleton is a global shared instance whose mutable state (analyticsId, cookieConsentValue, etc.) is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts without visible isolation or synchronization.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: Force unwrap of endpoint: NetworkConfiguration(endpoint: endpoint!)

candidates.explanation: The 'endpoint' variable is force-unwrapped without a visible guarantee that it cannot be nil, as it is derived from 'urlProvider.snowplowMicro' or 'urlProvider.snowplow'.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
